summary: Michael and Makana von Gortler died in an apparent fall on Missouri Mountain; found after a five-day search
notes: Found after five-day search MERGED run 94: DCSAR Belay On! (Nov 2011) "710 Call Dispatch" summer roundup lists "a three day out-of-county search on Mt. Missouri" — DCSAR assisted the out-of-county search for the von Gortlers (existing notes cite a five-day search; DCSAR may have fielded for 3 of those days). MERGED run 191: July-2012 Mountain Mail "Chaffee County Search and Rescue" feature — mission scale per Chaffee Undersheriff John Spezze: 5-6 day search, ~250 volunteer hikers, ~9 dogs, and a High Altitude Flight Center (HAATS) helicopter; CCSAR North/South both deployed. MERGED run 548: Colorado Army National Guard recovery account — HAATS UH-60 aircrew (Col. Joel Best, Maj. Josh Day) spotted the bodies ~9:30 a.m. Saturday at ~12,000 ft, ~500 ft above the main trail; second body 200 yds above the first; bodies airlifted to the field command post; coroner identified Robert Michael Von Gortler, 53, and Makana Von Gortler, 20, of Boulder (reported missing June 28; search began June 29; ~180 volunteers from 18 SAR teams; OH-58 Kiowa aerial support earlier in the week). Merged run 611: Colorado Central Magazine regional roundup (parent-opened) corroborates June 22 deaths of Dr. Robert Michael Von Gortler and Makana Von Gortler, autopsy blunt force trauma, coroner ruled accidental. [MERGE run645: DVIDS Minuteman Report newscast (Video ID 120237, date taken 07.07.2011) of the Guard UH-60 recovery of the missing father/daughter (missing since 6/28/2011)]
